lead_raw_text:
The structure of Yb4Al2Sn2 (reduced formula Yb2AlSn) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with eight atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Al in a tetrahedral environment with four Sn neighbors, while Sn shows five geometric neighbors (two Al, three Yb), and Yb adopts a close-packed-like arrangement with 12 neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner- and edge-sharing between Al tetrahedra and Sn 5-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between Al tetrahedra and Yb 12-vertex polyhedra.
